verses.restored: Bless YHWH, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

familiar.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

modern.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.

original.text: לְדָוִ֨ד בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל קְ֝רָבַ֗י אֶת שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשֽׁוֹ

verses.restored: Bless YHWH, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

familiar.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

modern.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—

original.text: בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וְאַל תִּ֝שְׁכְּחִ֗י כָּל גְּמוּלָֽיו

verses.restored: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

familiar.text: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

modern.text: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,

original.text: הַסֹּלֵ֥חַ לְכָל עֲוֺנֵ֑כִי הָ֝רֹפֵ֗א לְכָל תַּחֲלֻאָֽיְכִי

familiar.text: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

modern.text: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,

modern.text: who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

original.text: הַמַּשְׂבִּ֣יַע בַּטּ֣וֹב עֶדְיֵ֑ךְ תִּתְחַדֵּ֖שׁ כַּנֶּ֣שֶׁר נְעוּרָֽיְכִי

verses.restored: YHWH executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

familiar.text: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

modern.text: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.

original.text: עֹשֵׂ֣ה צְדָק֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטִ֗ים לְכָל עֲשׁוּקִֽים

verses.restored: He made known his ways to Moses, his acts to the children of Israel.

familiar.text: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

modern.text: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.

original.text: יוֹדִ֣יעַ דְּרָכָ֣יו לְמֹשֶׁ֑ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֲלִילֽוֹתָיו

familiar.text: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

modern.text: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.

original.text: רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֣וּן יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֖רֶךְ אַפַּ֣יִם וְרַב חָֽסֶד

verses.restored: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

familiar.text: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

modern.text: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.

original.text: לֹֽא לָנֶ֥צַח יָרִ֑יב וְלֹ֖א לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִטּֽוֹר

verses.restored: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

familiar.text: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

modern.text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.

original.text: לֹ֣א כַ֭חֲטָאֵינוּ עָ֣שָׂה לָ֑נוּ וְלֹ֥א כַ֝עֲוֺנֹתֵ֗ינוּ גָּמַ֥ל עָלֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

familiar.text: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

modern.text: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.

original.text: כִּ֤י כִגְבֹ֣הַּ שָׁ֭מַיִם עַל הָאָ֑רֶץ גָּבַ֥ר חַ֝סְדּ֗וֹ עַל יְרֵאָֽיו

verses.restored: As far as east is from west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

familiar.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

modern.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.

original.text: כִּרְחֹ֣ק מִ֭זְרָח מִֽמַּֽעֲרָ֑ב הִֽרְחִ֥יק מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ אֶת פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: Like as a father pitieth his children, so YHWH pitieth them that fear him.

familiar.text: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.

modern.text: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.

original.text: כְּרַחֵ֣ם אָ֭ב עַל בָּנִ֑ים רִחַ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל יְרֵאָֽיו

verses.restored: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

familiar.text: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

modern.text: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.

original.text: כִּי ה֖וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ

verses.restored: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

familiar.text: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

modern.text: As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field;

original.text: אֱ֭נוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִ֣יר יָמָ֑יו כְּצִ֥יץ הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה כֵּ֣ן יָצִֽיץ

verses.restored: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

familiar.text: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

modern.text: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.

original.text: כִּ֤י ר֣וּחַ עָֽבְרָה בּ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְלֹא יַכִּירֶ֖נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקוֹמֽוֹ

verses.restored: But the mercy of YHWH is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness to children’s children;

familiar.text: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;

modern.text: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—

original.text: וְחֶ֤סֶד יְהוָ֨ה מֵעוֹלָ֣ם וְעַד ע֭וֹלָם עַל יְרֵאָ֑יו וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ לִבְנֵ֥י בָנִֽים

verses.restored: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

familiar.text: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

modern.text: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.

original.text: לְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י בְרִית֑וֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵ֥י פִ֝קֻּדָ֗יו לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם

verses.restored: YHWH hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

familiar.text: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

modern.text: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.

original.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה בַּ֭שָּׁמַיִם הֵכִ֣ין כִּסְא֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכוּת֗וֹ בַּכֹּ֥ל מָשָֽׁלָה

familiar.text: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

modern.text: Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word, who hearken to the voice of His command.

original.text: בָּרֲכ֥וּ יְהוָ֗ה מַלְאָ֫כָ֥יו גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹ֭חַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ

familiar.text: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

modern.text: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, you servants who do His will.

original.text: בָּרֲכ֣וּ יְ֭הוָה כָּל צְבָאָ֑יו מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו עֹשֵׂ֥י רְצוֹנֽוֹ

verses.restored: Bless YHWH, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless YHWH, O my soul.

familiar.text: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.

modern.text: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!

original.text: בָּרֲכ֤וּ יְהוָ֨ה כָּֽל מַעֲשָׂ֗יו בְּכָל מְקֹמ֥וֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֑וֹ בָּרֲכִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת יְהוָֽה

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Healing language is not a promise that every illness will be cured or proof that illness reflects sin.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
